$Comment: Wear the whole Flaming Hallowed Set: its four armour pieces with the Flaming Jack Shield in the
utility slot. GEAR_SET_TIER counts a set's bonus tier coming on as gear goes on, its amount the
number of pieces that tier takes, so Amount 5 is met the moment the set's five-piece tier
(GearSets/HallowsEvePack/Hallows_Eve_Flaming_Hallowed.json) comes on. Logging in already dressed
counts nothing: the pieces have to go on.
Earned once and kept, like Flaming Armour, the first rung of the chain
wear_hallows_eve_flaming_hallowed: no Parent, no hallowed tag, and nothing paid but its points.

sentence names the set by its title and reads much the same; the key keeps the pack's own
